Documentation › Settings reference

Every Settings page and option

Each page of the Settings app, its groups and every option, generated from Settings' source

This page lists, for every page of Settings in the sidebar's order, its groups and the options on them, with the explanation Settings shows under each one. It is generated from the Settings app's source code, so it matches this release. Lists that depend on your computer (Wi-Fi networks, printers, Bluetooth devices, users, apps) are filled in when the page opens and aren't shown here.

The settings behind these options are listed in GSettings keys.

#Power

Screen

  • Screen blank — Turn the screen off after a period of inactivity

Automatic Suspend

Power Button and Lid

  • Power button
  • Closing the lid

Power mode

Battery

  • Charge
  • Show battery percentage — Next to the battery icon in the top bar
  • Turn on Battery Saver (Never, At 10%, At 20%, At 30%, At 50%) — Power Saver mode on battery below this charge, off again when you plug in
  • Battery health
  • Limit charging to 80% — Keeping a battery below full makes it last years longer. Turn off before a trip for a full charge.

#Appearance

Background

  • Personalize your background
  • Movement — Light moving over the picture, or a slow drift into it. Neither runs while a window covers the desktop.
  • Series — The same landscape at dawn, day, dusk and night
  • Scene — Drawn frame by frame, and never while a window covers the desktop
  • Recent images
  • Picture from — Aurora asks the service for today's picture once a day; nothing else is sent
  • Pictures from
  • Change picture every (15 minutes, 1 hour, 6 hours, 24 hours)
  • Shuffle the picture order
  • Choose a color

Style

  • Color scheme (Light, Dark, Auto) — Auto switches to dark at sunset and back at sunrise
  • Density (Comfortable, Compact) — How much room the top bar, menus and the dock take
  • Icon style — How the app icons are drawn, all of them at once
  • Accent color
  • Color from the background — The most vivid color of your background becomes the accent
  • Icons
  • Pointer
  • Pointer size
  • Animations
  • Window animations — Windows fade in as they open; files and folders float in as a folder opens

Fonts

  • Scaling
  • Anti-aliasing (Standard (grayscale), Subpixel (for LCD screens), None)
  • Hinting (Slight, None, Medium, Full)

Night Light

  • Night Light
  • Not available on this screen — The graphics driver doesn't allow color changes (usual in a virtual machine).
  • Schedule (Sunset to Sunrise, Manual, All the Time) — Sunset and sunrise follow your time zone
  • Color temperature

Lock Screen

  • Picture
  • Background (Same as the desktop, The desktop's, blurred, A picture)
  • Show my name and picture — Off: only the time, the date and the password field

Source: desktop/aurora/settingsapp/appearance.py

#AI

Aurora AI

  • Aurora AI
  • Assistant button in the top bar — The Assistant is also in the dock and opens with Super+Shift+Space

Answers Come From

  • Provider (This computer (private), Anthropic Claude, OpenAI-compatible API)

Model on This Computer

Cloud Provider

  • API keys are paid per use — Every answer uses credits billed by the provider, separately from any Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT Plus subscription, which API keys don't use. Check prices and set a spending limit in the provider's console. Answers on this computer are free.
  • API key
  • Claude model
  • Service — Fills in the address; then add your key and a model name
  • API address
  • Model

Where Aurora AI Helps

  • Writing tools
  • Files
  • Screenshots
  • Notifications
  • Ask from Spotlight — Type ? and a question. Super+Shift+Space opens the Assistant.
  • Terminal commands — ask "what to do" suggests a command; why explains the last error
  • Dictation — Super+H, speak, Super+H again: the text is typed where you are. Speech recognition runs on this computer (Whisper).
  • Dictation accuracy (Quick (Whisper base), Accurate (Whisper small))
  • Read aloud — Select text anywhere and press Super+Shift+R (a natural voice for your language, Piper)
  • Search documents by meaning — Spotlight finds files by what they're about, not only their name
  • Folders to index
  • Update the Index Now

Storage

  • Space used by AI
  • Remove All AI Downloads

Languages

  • Answers in
  • Dictation language
  • Read-aloud voice
